final: WITH t AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY production_type_code), b AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS base FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), k AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.a FROM t, b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL AND t.a > b.base), m AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS mk FROM k), f AS (SELECT k.a FROM k, m WHERE k.a > m.mk) SELECT AVG(f.a) AS avg_type_avg_price, AVG(f.a - b.base) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(f.a - m.mk) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM f, b, m
